Select molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5162' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
